Product

Product Designer

Remote — US / EU · Full-time

Design an accessibility product that is itself exemplary. Everything you ship gets audited by the same standard we sell.

What you'll do

  • Design the audit, reporting and monitoring surfaces end to end
  • Own the design system, including its contrast and focus behaviour
  • Prototype with real assistive technology in the loop
  • Make complex compliance information legible to non-technical buyers

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years product design, ideally on data-dense B2B products
  • Genuine accessibility fluency — you design for keyboard and screen reader first
  • Comfortable working in code or very close to it

Apply

Send your CV and a short note on why this role interests you to info@accessrank.ai. Mention the role title so it reaches the right inbox.
